in_marathi.name: Chandraprakaash
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandraprakaash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chandraprakaash is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Chandra' meaning moon and 'Prakaash' meaning radiance or light. This name is associated with the god Chandra, who is known as the god of the moon. It signifies the light that the moon emits, illuminating the night sky.
